# 2.21.0

- Add `createResourceScope` at root and `/client`: reverse-order resource ownership,
  explicit parallel disposal groups, late-acquisition cleanup, original startup error
  preservation, shared close and separate actual settlement after a close deadline.
- Add `createReconciler` over the existing serial queue: burst coalescing, fresh reads,
  owned subscription/cancellation, caller-chosen keyed retries, observable errors and
  idempotent shutdown. Existing queue and service host policies are unchanged.
- Ship a generated hosting ownership example and a consumer-specific Docker/LXD
  migration patch. Provider policies stay in the application; no installed consumer
  package is patched. Document cancellation limits and exact retry semantics.
- Add ownership/reconcile race regressions and public inference checks. Verify the
  real migrated agent sources with their existing protocol fixtures in an isolated
  consumer, before and after publishing the exact npm version.
